description: This PHP class, ClaimAttachmentDecorator, provides a decorator pattern implementation for the ClaimAttachment entity within the OrangeHRM system. It facilitates access to and modification of claim attachment data, including retrieving the attachment as a string and associating a user by user ID.

classes.name: ClaimAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that wraps around the ClaimAttachment entity, providing additional functionality and easier access to attachment content and associated user data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a specific ClaimAttachment instance.

methods.name: setUserByUserId
methods.description: Associates a User entity with the ClaimAttachment based on the provided user ID.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves the attachment content as a string, reading from the attachment stream if not already fetched.
